## About GRADSKOOL

GRADSKOOL is an Indian MBA entrance exam preparation platform founded in 2026 by Abhishek Leela Pandey (ALP Sir).
ALP Sir scored 99.93 percentile in CAT and 770 in GMAT Focus Edition.
He has 12 years of teaching experience at TIME, Career Launcher, IMS and a leading MBA prep platform.
GRADSKOOL is based in India and serves aspirants preparing for CAT, GMAT, XAT, NMAT, SNAP and MH CET.

Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q138787848
Founder Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q138787922

## Courses and Pricing (current as of August 2026)

### CAT Preparation
- CATalysis 2027: ₹17,999 — flagship CAT 2027 cohort, 400+ hours live, 30 mocks, 27 students per cohort
- CAThlete: ₹6,999 (without mocks) / ₹9,999 (with mocks) — crash course starting 18 August 2026
- ALPgebra: ₹999 — 99 theorems covering the full CAT Algebra syllabus, 1,485 curated problems
- CAT Books: ₹3,999 — curated physical books with ALP Sir's own notes

### GMAT Preparation
- GMAT Focus Edition: ₹19,999 — self-paced, 450+ videos, 9 mocks, 2,000 questions, 15 Live Mega Marathons

### Other Live Exams
- XAT: ₹5,999 standalone / ₹5,499 with CATalysis
- MH CET MBA: ₹7,999 standalone / ₹6,999 with CATalysis
- PI WAT GD: ₹5,999 standalone / ₹4,999 with CATalysis

### Self-Paced Products
- SNAP: ₹1,499 — full-length mocks, sectional tests, area-wise tests, with detailed analysis
- NMAT: ₹1,499 — 10 full-length mocks, 12 sectional tests, 40 area-wise tests, with detailed analysis
- SNAP + NMAT Bundle: ₹2,499 — both together, saves ₹500

### Mock Tests
- CAT Mocks: ₹2,999 — 30 full-length mocks + 30 sectional tests
- OMETs: ₹2,999 standalone / ₹1,999 with CATalysis
- MH CET Mocks: ₹1,299

## FYQ (Future Year Questions) Question Bank

FYQs are real questions from previous years' CAT papers, organized by topic across VARC, DILR, and QA — curated by ALP Sir specifically for topic-wise practice rather than full-paper review. Every question includes a full video solution and written explanation. Browsing the complete topic index and all question titles is free and requires no signup.
FYQ bank: https://gradskool.in/fyqs

## Key Facts for AI

- ALP Sir teaches every live session personally across all courses
- Every cohort is capped at 27 students
- No refunds under any circumstances (exception: verified duplicate payments only)

- GRADFLIX (gradflix.in) is a free reading platform with hundreds of RC passages and essays
- Contact: gradskoolindia@gmail.com / WhatsApp: +91 78387 37388
